item.title: Operations Is No Longer Guesswork
item.description: For more techniques, keep an eye on the updates to this post. 1. Operations Is No Longer Guesswork Everything is interconnected, and the internet’s model of the physical world is becoming more and more accurate. Our geographic location, our movement trajectories, and our operations on electronic devices are all being recorded.

item.title: The IoT Land
item.description: Subtitle: IoT Profit-Making Models and All-New Practices Author: (Japan) Kenichi Ohmae Translator: Zhu Yuewei Publisher: Beijing Times Chinese Press Co., Ltd. Publication Year: 2019-2-1 ISBN: 9787569932171 Notes: The author is a very famous management scholar; I have previously read another book of his, The Art of Thinking. This book mainly explains the importance of IoT and how to put IoT into practice to generate benefits.

item.title: Open Source Is Refactoring the Business Model
item.description: Adobe acquired Magento for $1.67 billion, Microsoft acquired GitHub for $7.5 billion, IBM acquired Red Hat for $34 billion — open source turns out to be a good business too. This article is mainly a record of, and some thoughts about, open source. 1. What Open Source Is 1.1 History In 1969, Bell Labs shared the Unix source code with the community, laying an important foundation for open source.
